categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the consumer electronics sector, focusing on acoustic products including various types of headphones such as in-ear, over-ear, TWS (True Wireless Stereo), OWS (Open Wearable Stereo), and bone conduction headphones. It also develops and manufactures smart wearable devices like AR/VR/MR glasses, smart rings, and health-related products such as hearing aids and smart health monitoring devices. Additionally, the company produces electronic components and accessories for communication devices, automotive applications, and professional audio equipment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages core acoustic technologies including LE Audio, spatial audio, active noise cancellation, wireless Bluetooth, and waterproofing technologies. It integrates sound, light, and electrical technologies with medical applications, supported by a strong R&D system with over 500 patents. Manufacturing involves vertically integrated supply chain capabilities from components to finished products, with advanced production lines and MES-based information management systems across multiple facilities in China and Malaysia.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are leading global and domestic brands in consumer electronics, including well-known names such as Sennheiser, Philips, Motorola, Marshall, Amazon, Bose, and others. The company serves markets in communications, entertainment, sports, healthcare, and automotive sectors. Its products are sold predominantly through direct sales channels to these brand customers, with a strong presence in both professional and consumer audio markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with manufacturing bases in Jiangxi, Guangdong, and overseas in Malaysia and planned expansion in Thailand. Its sales cover domestic markets and international regions including Asia-Pacific, the United States, and Europe, with approximately 77% of revenue generated from overseas markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates as an Original Design Manufacturer (ODM) with vertical integration across the supply chain, from core acoustic components to module design and full product assembly. This integration enhances production efficiency, quality control, and responsiveness to customer needs, positioning the company midstream to downstream in the supply chain as a comprehensive solution provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on deepening acoustic technology expertise, expanding into health medical devices, and integrating sound, light, and electrical technologies. R&D priorities include smart wearable devices, AI-enabled audio products, AR/AI glasses, industrial noise-cancelling headphones, and medical-grade hearing aids. The company invests heavily in innovation, with a growing R&D team and projects targeting emerging technologies like AI, spatial computing, and Bluetooth audio broadcasting (Auracast).
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of finished acoustic and wearable devices under ODM contracts with major brand customers. The company also earns income from sales of electronic components and accessories. Direct sales dominate the revenue model, with minimal reliance on distribution channels. Additional income streams include government subsidies and investment income from financial products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with global and domestic manufacturers in the consumer electronics and acoustic device sectors. It holds a strong position as a trusted ODM partner for top-tier international brands, supported by advanced technology, manufacturing scale, and integrated supply chain capabilities. Its early entry into health medical acoustic products and smart wearable devices differentiates it from many competitors, positioning it as an innovative leader in the convergence of consumer electronics and healthcare.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 2.23 billion, representing a 26.85% year-over-year increase, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 211.75 million, up 55.59%. The company has shown strong growth in revenue and profitability, with significant cash flow improvements. Total assets reached RMB 2.76 billion, and equity attributable to shareholders was RMB 2.06 billion, reflecting steady expansion and financial stability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its nearly 30 years of acoustic expertise, comprehensive vertical integration, and strong R&D capabilities as key differentiators. It offers customized, innovative ODM solutions that integrate sound, light, electrical, and medical technologies, enabling multifunctional smart wearable devices. Its ability to rapidly adapt to customer needs, combined with advanced manufacturing and quality control, provides high-quality, cost-effective products with enhanced intelligent features, positioning it as a preferred partner in the evolving consumer electronics and health tech markets.
